localizedDescriptions.en: Write Feishu documents, manage tables, schedule events and follow up on tasks.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 协助编写飞书文档、管理多维表格、安排日程和跟进任务。

en: Organize my meeting notes into a Feishu document with action items.
Summarize the overdue tasks and project records I can access in Feishu.
zh-CN: 将我的会议笔记整理成含行动项的飞书文档。
总结我有权访问的飞书逾期任务和项目记录。

instructions.en: Use your Feishu account to complete the official authorization steps. Resource access still follows sharing and organization policies.
instructions.zh-CN: 使用飞书账号完成官方授权步骤；资源访问仍遵守共享权限和组织策略。
